history.name: Citation_Expert
history.content: Task restatement and plan: We need the count of Twitter/X post citations on English Wikipedia pages for each day of August, using the page versions as they existed in June 2023. New approach: instead of downloading a full dump, we will use the MediaWiki API to fetch the last revision before 2023-06-30T23:59:59Z for each page titled "August 1", "August 2", ..., "August 31". Steps: (1) define detection patterns for Twitter/X citations (twitter.com/x.com status URLs, archived versions, and t.co links resolved within templates), (2) fetch each page's June 2023 revision text via action=query, (3) parse <ref> tags and citation templates for URLs and dates, (4) count references that point to specific tweets (status URLs etc.), (5) aggregate counts by day.

history.content: Detection criteria: Include references containing twitter.com or x.com with /status/[id]; include cite tweet templates; include archived links where the original is a Twitter/X status URL; include cite web with t.co if it expands to a status URL. Exclude profile pages or non-status links. Regex candidates: (1) twitter\.com/[^/]+/status/\d+, (2) x\.com/[^/]+/status/\d+, (3) web\.archive\.org/.+/https?://(twitter|x)\.com/[^/]+/status/\d+. For templates, check url, archive-url, and parameters like number/user in cite tweet. We'll use template parsing for {{cite web}}, {{cite tweet}}, and raw <ref> links.
